channel.title: Datarobot incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Datarobot's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Codespace Session Validation Failure in Generative AI Playground [resolved]
item.description: The fix is now deployed to all the Prod environments and Generative AI Playground is now working as expected.

item.title: Issues with Vector Database Creation [resolved]
item.description: Engineering team observed that the Vector Database creation is operational across all DataRobot MTS environments. The incident is Resolved.

item.title: Issues with prediction requests against custom model deployments [resolved]
item.description: The issue is contained and the team has verified that predictions against Custom Models in all MTSaaS environments are healthy.

item.title: Batch Jobs queued up in US MTS [resolved]
item.description: A fix has been deployed to production and the issue is now resolved. All systems are operating normally.

item.title: Delay in Feature Drift Statistics Processing [resolved]
item.description: Feature drift statistics processing has been restored to normal. All metrics are now up to date. No data was lost.

item.title: Customers Experiencing Errors with New Custom Model Creation. [resolved]
item.description: Custom Models, Custom Applications & Data upload services are back to Operational state in US SAAS Environment. Issue is Resolved.

item.title: Widespread intermittent service issues for new workloads in US Production [resolved]
item.description: Engineering confirmed the issue is resolved and all services are restored.

item.title: Delay in processing actual messages [resolved]
item.description: Engineering has applied the required infrastructure configuration changes. The service is operating normally and no further user impact is observed. Engineering will continue monitoring cluster health to ensure stability. The incident is now marked as Contained.

item.title: Elevated Errors on Managed AI Cloud [resolved]
item.description: Engineering has implemented the required fixes to resolve the elevated error rates. Services are now operating normally, and no further user impact has been observed. The team will continue to monitor the system to ensure stability. The incident is now considered contained.

item.title: Degraded Performance on DataRobot MTS due to Quay outage [resolved]
item.description: Quay.io functionality has been restored and DataRobot environments are fully stabilized.

item.title: Performance Degradation on Managed AI Cloud [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Intermittent UI disruptions on Managed AI Cloud [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Network issue related to Kubernetes in US cluster [resolved]
item.description: The mitigation implemented by Engineering has resolved the Kubernetes network issue, and the incident is now contained.

item.title: Degraded Performance on the DataRobot MTS due to Quay outage [resolved]
item.description: This incident is now resolved.

item.title: LLM blueprints deployments cannot be created [resolved]
item.description: Rollback of the JP cluster to the previous version is complete and the problem has been mitigated.

item.title: Agent Application Template Impacted After Moderations Library Upgrade. [resolved]
item.description: New version of Agentic application template is released, the issue is resolved

item.title: Degraded Performance on the DataRobot US MTS [resolved]
item.description: The incident has now been resolved. All services are now operational.

item.title: Problem connecting to DataRobot due to client browser caching [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Degraded Platform Performance Due to Docker Hub Outage [resolved]
item.description: Between 16:50 UTC and 17:09 UTC, one of external providers(DockerHub) had an outage that might have caused temporary delays in starting platform workloads. The issue has been resolved and normal operations have resumed. Engineering is continuing to monitor the system.

item.title: Degraded Platform Performance Due to Docker Hub Outage [resolved]
item.description: The engineering team has confirmed recovery across all MTS and STS environments. No further updates are expected.

item.title: Some Users Facing Issues In Accessing Notebooks/Codespaces in US/EU/JP MTS. [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Some Users Are Unable To Login Into US,EU & JP MTS clusters. [resolved]
item.description: The issue is fixed. Access to the US, EU, and JP clusters is restored.

item.title: The AutoML experiment creation workflow and visibility of certain tabs impacted in MTS environments [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved.

item.title: Notebooks are timing out occasionally on US Production. [resolved]
item.description:
The Engineering team hasn't observed any new occurrences during monitoring.
All services remain fully operational.

item.title: Data Connectors Hanging on Creation [resolved]
item.description:
The Engineering team has successfully resolved the connection and processing timeouts affecting data operations in MTS Production.
Services are now running stable.

item.title: Temporary Access Issue for Org Admins to Custom Applications [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: AWS services outage affects STS and MTS DataRobot environments [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. AWS is reporting systems as operational. Engineering will continue to monitor the situation.

item.title: UI Issue Affecting Model Visibility and Project Management [resolved]
item.description: Engineering team has applied the fix to address UI issue affecting Model Visibility and Project Management. This problem has now been resolved.

item.title: Issue With DockerHub Services Impacting MTS & STS DataRobot Clusters. [resolved]
item.description: Issue is resolved and DataRobot MTS & STS services are back to normal.

item.title: Users in APAC region are experiencing network issues when accessing application endpoints in US MTS [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.
